stem.text: Enzyme P has been found in a tropical grass.

items: The enzyme catalyses the hydrolysis of the fungal polysaccharide, chitin, into amino sugars.
It also inhibits the activity of an enzyme in locust guts which catalyses the digestion of amylose.

stem.text: Which row describes the actions of enzyme P?

A.text: hydrolysis of glycosidic bonds; condensation of glycosidic bonds

B.text: hydrolysis of glycosidic bonds; hydrolysis of glycosidic bonds

C.text: hydrolysis of peptide bonds; condensation of glycosidic bonds

D.text: hydrolysis of peptide bonds; hydrolysis of glycosidic bonds
